subject.title: fix(ssh-verify): preserve active cooldown entries during prune

question: When the cooldown map is full of unexpired entries, should a new failure be left uncached, or is a different bounded admission policy required?
rationale: The current patch cannot simultaneously retain every active entry and enforce the existing hard size bound; the required behavior for the incoming key determines the correct repair.

options.title: Reject new entry when full
options.body: Retain existing active cooldowns, keep the map at its maximum size, and allow the newly observed key to proceed without a cached cooldown.

options.title: Adopt another bounded policy
options.body: Specify and test a deterministic replacement or admission policy if the new key must receive cooldown protection.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Hold the change if the intended capacity-versus-coverage policy needs broader gateway-owner discussion.

recommendation.title: Reject new entry when full
recommendation.body: Retain existing active cooldowns, keep the map at its maximum size, and allow the newly observed key to proceed without a cached cooldown.
